payout_quote: A judge's basic salary is $185 for Election Day. Judges will receive an additional $40 when they attend a training class.
steps: Complete the election judge application and return it to the Winnebago County Election Department (404 Elm St, Room 101, Rockford, IL 61101) or email elections@clerk.wincoil.gov, or call 815-319-4252.
Attend a training/refresher class before the election to qualify for the additional $40.
Help set up the polling site the Monday before the election (about one hour).
Report for duty at 5:15 A.M. on Election Day; remain at the polls through close (7:00 P.M.) and tally/certify results; two judges return voted ballots to the Election Office.
catches: The county flyer covers precincts outside the City limits of Rockford, under the jurisdiction of the Winnebago County Clerk (Rockford city precincts are handled by the City Board of Elections).
Pay is a fixed stipend: $185 for Election Day plus $40 for attending training.
No fixed end time is given: polls close at 7:00 P.M., then judges tally the vote, certify results, and two judges transport ballots back to the Election Office.
biggest_catch: Fixed $185 Election Day stipend (+$40 training) with a long day: 5:15 A.M. reporting through poll close and post-close tally/ballot transport, ending well after 7:00 P.M.
eligibility: U.S. citizen; resident of and registered to vote in Winnebago County; of good repute and character; able to speak, read, and write English; able to follow instructions; responsible for own transportation.
timing: Report at 5:15 A.M. on Election Day; polls open 6:00 A.M.–7:00 P.M.; judges must remain the entire time, then tally, certify, and return ballots.
weasel_words: This process usually only takes about one hour or so

c1.evidence: Winnebago County's official election-judge flyer: 'A judge's basic salary is $185 for Election Day. Judges will receive an additional $40 when they attend a training class.'

c2.evidence: Winnebago County's official election-judge flyer: 'judges report for duty at the polling place at 5:15 am. Polls open at 6:00 am and close at 7:00 pm. Election judges need to remain at the polls this entire time.'

c3.evidence: Both pay and hours are published on wincoil.gov, Winnebago County's own official website, in the county's official election-judge recruitment flyer.

c4.evidence: Publisher is the Winnebago County Election Department/County Clerk — the county's own election authority; the flyer is live on wincoil.gov with rates in present tense and no obsolescence date, and the clerk is reported as recruiting 500+ election judges for the November General Election (Rockford Register Star, 2026-08-10).

s1.note: Compensation numeric and concrete: $185 Election Day salary + $40 training attendance.

s2.note: Hours explicit: 5:15 A.M. report; polls 6:00 A.M.–7:00 P.M.; must remain the entire time; close and ballot transport after 7:00 P.M.

s3.note: Application and contact path explicit: mail to 404 Elm St Room 101, email elections@clerk.wincoil.gov, or call 815-319-4252.

s4.note: Mileage beyond the stipend: not stated by the county — treated as not published.

s5.note: Single judge salary ($185) published; no role-based tiers stated.

s6.note: Eligibility fully stated: citizenship, county residence/registration, good character, English, own transportation.

s7.note: No fees or cost barriers identified.

notes: Winnebago County, Illinois election judges (precincts outside City of Rockford). Fixed stipend model: $185 for Election Day + $40 for attending a training class. Long day from 5:15 A.M. through close with post-close tally and ballot transport.
payout_value_note: Fixed stipend: $185 for Election Day; $225 if the judge also attends a training/refresher class ($40).
numeric_basis: 5:15 A.M. report to 7:00 P.M. poll close = 13.75 hours (825 minutes), plus post-close tally, certification, and ballot transport to the Election Office — reasonably 14.5–17 hours total (870–1020 minutes).
